emails.name: The missing layer

subject_lines.primary: Your agents finish. Your company continues.
subject_lines.variation_a: The missing layer above your AI agents

emails.preview_text: Cambium is built for the part of business that never reaches done.
emails.body:
A brand can be minted. A site can be shipped. A campaign can end.

Those are finite games, and finishing them is correct.

The company is different. It has to carry its cause, limits, and learning from one finished game into the next. Until now, the founder has been the only layer doing that work.

Cambium is the living operator above bounded AI agents. It wakes on evidence, checks the venture's ability to continue, proposes the next finite game, gates consequence, and leaves a receipt.

Not a synthetic founder. Not an activity swarm. A continuity layer for the real steward.
emails.ps: P.S. Every visual in this launch is illustrative. Live product claims will carry their own receipts.

emails.name: Name the bound

subject_lines.primary: What would force your venture out of the game?
subject_lines.variation_a: Start with the bound that keeps you awake
subject_lines.variation_b: Solvency is a bound, not the mission

emails.preview_text: Continuity begins by naming what cannot be crossed.
emails.body:
The fastest way to make an agent system unsafe is to give it one number to maximize.

Revenue matters. So do founder capacity, mission coherence, legal limits, and trust. None of them is the whole game.

Cambium begins with a smaller question: what margin must remain positive for this venture to keep playing?

Name the bound. Name the evidence. Then choose the finite move that widens the margin without hiding consequence.

That is viability in practice—less grand than autonomy, and far more useful.
emails.ps: P.S. We do not claim to compute an exact high-dimensional viability kernel. We use explicit bounds and observable proxy margins.

emails.name: One wake

subject_lines.primary: One event. One bounded decision. One receipt.
subject_lines.variation_a: What a Cambium wake actually does
subject_lines.variation_b: The opposite of an activity feed

emails.preview_text: Event → viability check → proposal → gate → receipt → rest.
emails.body:
Cambium is quiet by default.

A real event arrives. The operator checks its source, freshness, and relevance. It reads current world-state and the margins that matter. It proposes one finite game.

If the move is reversible and authorized, it can proceed. If it spends, publishes, changes identity, or cannot be undone, it stops at the founder gate.

The outcome lands with its evidence and authority. Then Cambium returns to dormancy.

No celebration for staying busy. No success claim without the work. Just one legible operating step.
emails.ps: P.S. Replace this draft link only with a current, verifiable demonstration.

emails.name: Authority stays human

subject_lines.primary: Cambium does not replace the founder
subject_lines.variation_b: What stays behind the founder gate

emails.body:
If a system can act, it needs a clear answer to a harder question: who is allowed to cause consequence?

Cambium separates routine bounded work from actions that spend money, publish externally, change identity, move data, or create an irreversible commitment.

The first class can be pre-authorized. The second remains human.

The point is not to keep the founder clicking approve all day. It is to make the boundary explicit enough that the quiet work can happen safely—and the consequential work can never hide inside it.
emails.ps: P.S. A founder gate is useful only when the default is fail-closed and the receipt names the exact authority.

emails.name: First mapping

subject_lines.variation_a: Ready to map the first finite game?

emails.preview_text: Begin with the venture, the bound, and one evidence-bearing event.
emails.body:
You do not need a synthetic company on day one.

Start with one real venture. Name its near-invariant vision. Name the mission that can renew. Name the bound whose collapse would force the game to stop. Then choose one event that should wake the operator.

That is enough to test whether Cambium makes the next decision more viable, more legible, and less dependent on constant vigilance.

If it does not, the receipt should tell us why.
emails.ps: P.S. No artificial deadline. The right time to begin is when the evidence and authority are ready.
